pictures.name: SL1-Cool-Grove
pictures.prompt: Ancient India, a cool forest grove of tall sal trees with dappled light. A young Buddhist monk with a shaved head and an ochre robe, lean and earnest, walks slowly back and forth along a worn earthen path, eyes lowered, tired but determined. Morning mist, green and gold light. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
